plugins.name: keel
plugins.description: Keeps a Claude Code agent on course at scale — memory, big picture, real intent, verification, and traceability, via hooks and skills.

skills.name: adversarial-review
skills.description: Use at TWO moments, always. (1) When you have FINISHED a design / plan and are about to ask the user to approve it (e.g. closing the Design section of an /add-task, before the approval checkpoint) — run an adversarial critic that tries to demolish it FIRST. (2) When you have FINISHED implementing something and are about to declare it done — run a verifier + tester FIRST. Turns thesis into antithesis into synthesis (what survives). Addresses the loop-bug FM4; un-confuted design and un-verified implementation are the reason real bugs accumulate.
headings: 1. Design closed → REFUTE before asking for approval
2. Implementation finished → VERIFY + TEST before declaring it done
skills.description_zh: 在设计计划提交批准前进行对抗评审，在实现声明完成前执行验证测试，通过质疑和核验发现设计及实现漏洞。

skills.name: design-log-method
skills.description: Use when the user asks to implement, build, add, change, or fix something non-trivial (touches ~3+ files, is a new feature, or involves an architectural decision), OR when the user asks to capture a quick note (a "note"/"segna" verb). Ensures significant work never bypasses the Design-Log process, even as sessions grow long.
skills.description_zh: 对涉及约3个以上文件、新功能或架构决策的非简单实施及快速笔记采用Design-Log流程，保留重要工作决策记录。

skills.name: guardian
skills.description: Use BEFORE any significant decision or implementation, and especially when STARTING or SWITCHING a task (e.g. after /add-task) or resuming after a break/compaction — to verify it aligns with the project's NORTH_STAR (essence + invariants), the current FOCUS objective, and the cardinal principles. Catches hyper-focusing on the immediate sub-task while forgetting the overarching goal (e.g. building a feature while forgetting the project is a SaaS sold to clients).
headings: Guardian — consistency with context / objective / principles
skills.description_zh: 在重要决定、实施、任务启动切换或压缩恢复前，检查与项目NORTH_STAR本质和不变量、当前FOCUS及核心原则一致，防止局部任务偏离整体目标。

skills.name: methodical-debugging
skills.description: Use when something is BROKEN or not behaving as expected — a bug, a failed test, a crash, a wrong output, 'it doesn't work' — BEFORE proposing or trying any fix. Forces the systematic protocol (instrument/observe the real flow, design tests/scenarios, run and READ the real output, diff expected vs actual, only then hypothesize and fix) instead of blind trial-and-error, writes an auditable Debug-log (expected vs actual), and after repeated failed fixes stops to consult the project LEARNED and question the architecture. This is the method's own debugging discipline (self-contained), tied to the project principi/GUARDIAN — not a generic reminder.
headings: Methodical debugging — not by trial and error (FM5)
Boundary with the other skills (don't overlap)
Debug-log (MANDATORY — this is what makes the ritual auditable)
After ~2 failed fixes on the same spot → STOP
skills.description_zh: 在提出修复前系统观察真实执行流、设计运行测试、读取输出并比较期望实际，再形成假设修复，记录可审计Debug-log；反复失败时查项目经验并质疑架构。
